events.title: Lifting a 2.8 t pipe section
events.detail: Wet clay, 12° cross-slope toward the trench.

events.title: Seatbelt released on a 12° slope
events.detail: Operator unbuckles to lean out and see the trench edge.

events.title: Hydraulic lockout
events.detail: Seatbelt interlock freezes boom, stick and slew with the load held.

events.title: Without assist: machine rolls downhill
events.detail: Stability margin below 1.0× at full reach. Unbelted operator ejected.

events.title: Downhill slew blocked
events.detail: Margin 1.30×. Retract the stick and lower the load to continue.

events.title: Load in close, slew released
events.detail: Margin back above 1.6×. Pipe laid with the load tucked in.

outcome.assisted: Load laid safely. Stability never fell below 1.26×, and no load moved while the belt was open.
outcome.unassisted: Machine rolls into the trench with an unbelted operator. Ejection and crush injury.
